content.short: CryptoRank provides real-time market data, fundraising database, dashboards, and a Web3 portfolio tracker.
content.description: CryptoRank delivers real-time market data, a fundraising database, analytical dashboards, and a Web3 portfolio tracker for traders and investors, along with other tools for managing digital asset activity. It supports users in organizing their portfolio by allowing up to 50 wallets across nine blockchains and presenting all assets in a single interface. This consolidation makes it easier to monitor ICOs and crypto investments, with the goal of maximizing returns and boosting overall portfolio performance.
